args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

Summary of what I did:
- **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1, unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 (last healthy production version) to all regions — confirmed rolled out and verified.
- **Opened incident**: SEV2 `INC-0001` for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the health-check failure and the rollback action taken.

transcript.reasoning_content: Let me start by understanding the current state of checkout-api. I need to check service status and deployment history.

Let me roll back and open incident.
